user.title: Connect miner
user.description: Antminer running Braiins OS. Control uses SSH (port 22), status uses the API (port 4028). Braiins OS usually has no root password – leave it empty then.{error}

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check IP, SSH access and network.

init.title: minerctl options
init.description: Power per mode in watts (roughly 400–1420 with 3 boards; below that the tuner floor applies). Boards cannot be switched off via software on this S9 – all boards always run.
